design.name: Rev D 1.5 m solar-sail drone
design.revision_note: Rev D (12 Nov 2026): Rev C5 plus a limp-home controller, potted electronics, RockBLOCK Plus in the hatch lid, main GPS to the stern post. From Rev C: C5: wing 0.80 x 0.375 m (same area), 11 Nov 2026; C4: acetal mast bearings; C3: structural review changes (YB3 to the foredeck, fibreglass post and counterweight arm, servo-savers, 30 x 22 spar), 11 Nov 2026; C2: hardwood keel fin; C1: electronics box above the flood level
